strings.en: Tch...! It can't hold out any longer...!
Oh dear...@How uncool of me, honestly!
Taken down in a place like this...@I'm still so green...!
I leave the rest to you...
To think someone could force me back...!!
Tch!! What an early curtain call!
Th-This is as far as I go...!
Ngh! So this is my limit...!
I'm ejecting, I am...@Ngh...! I can't even go out with dignity...
Damn it!@You won't get me next time!
Kyah! I leave the rest to you!
Me, screwing up in a place like this...?!@This is no fun...
So I, too, still have much to learn...!
A-All hands!@Abandoning ship is top priority...!!
Dammit! Is this all I've got...?!
That was careless of me...@I'll pull back for now...!
Is this... as far as I go...?
Oh, no way! This is as far as I go!!
At my current skill...@this is as far as I go...!
Ngh... Me, made a shooting star...@I'm ejecting!
Ngggh! Not in a place like this!!
N-Not in a place like this...!
Sorry!@I'm gonna have to bow out...!
For the Granzon... to be shot down...
Damn it, is this as far as I go?!
I have no choice but to eject...!
Aw, man, they got me good!
All radiation readings from the Cross Gate@are growing stronger at an accelerating rate.
If we've searched this much and still found@no trace of Lord Euzeth...
We'd better look into it right away.
What are the Earth forces doing?
They're massing a fleet near the Cross Gate.@The Steel Dragons are heading there too.
Seems this won't end with a forced recon.@Depending on the situation, I'll go out too.
All radiation readings from the Cross Gate@are growing stronger at an accelerating rate.
Even so, we can't go inside the Gate.
I know. What are the Earth forces doing?
Thirty minutes ago, on top of neutron, heavy ion@and gamma radiation, CGP, an unknown particle@radiation, rose to 200 times its normal level.
At this rate, we expect a burst phenomenon@to occur within three to four hours.
If Lamaris, Ruina, or any similar hostiles@emerge from the Cross Gate,@we must stop them at the water's edge.
After that, we'll attempt to seal the Cross Gate@using the Granteed Dracodeus.
The situation is unpredictable.@Everyone, stay sharp out there. That is all.
...Even if the Ruina come out,@there's no telling they'll be like the last ones.
Right. They take their form from the image@of the first knowledge holder they contact.
I figured that was the Lamaris, but it seems not.
Later investigation produced a hypothesis@that the Lamaris appeared due to@the <Cross Gate Burst>.
It's true, the Lamaris showed up in cities@after the burst phenomenon occurred...
So that shower of light from the Cross Gate@is what those things are made from?
It didn't reach the ground directly,@but that may be the case.
Ugh, I hate this. Just once, I wish a champion@of justice would come out of the Cross Gate.
Don't be so quick to decide.@A champion of justice could turn up, you know.
The gates in the Endless Frontier spat out@all sorts, from heroes to monsters.
Still, gates to other dimensions, whatever they are,@have a strong image of bringing disaster.
(But this time, I'll stop it.@I won't let the army of ruin take form.)
...Bro, don't take it all on yourself.
Indeed. We are here as well.
Yeah, I know it's not something@I can accomplish on my own.
Wait, what?!@You've got the <Ariard> powered up?!
The Siebe Drive, to be precise.
When we went up into space@and checked the Siebe Drive,@its output had increased.
It's been running better and better@for about the last thirty minutes.
Perhaps it's reacting@to the Cross Gate.
Fairy, when you piloted the Ariard,@did the Siebe Drive ever act like this?
Hmm...@The Cross Gate was calm back then, after all.
But why would Herluga, an alien, build a drive@that reacts to the Cross Gate?
Perhaps there was one@on planet Gadisword too.
I-I've never heard anything like that...
Well, it's possible the Cross Gate's existence@was kept secret. We may have no choice@but to ask Herluga for the truth.
Lieutenant Irm, may I have a moment?
The truth is, I've been sensing something strange.
You said something like that when we went@up into space during the Sealing War, too.
Yeah... And right after that,@the Ares Geist showed up, didn't it?
So how do we confirm it?
If possible, please let me sortie ahead in the Exexbein.
All right. Go with Ryoto.@I'll get permission from the higher-ups.
Yes, sir.@I'm counting on you, Lieutenant Ryoto.
...I'm sorry, Lieutenant. For dragging you along.
It's fine. Do you still sense it?
Yes, from up ahead...@It feels like it's slowly getting stronger.
Given the situation, let's proceed carefully.
(So that unit came on ahead.@What a golden opportunity... No, perhaps@it is that man's guidance.)
All units, capture Eagret Ing's machine.@Ein, assess the situation, then move ahead.
Ing, your hunch was right.@Let's hold out until the Steel Dragons get here.
Ing... You are a lead to Lord Euzeth.@I won't let you escape.
(They're probably after me...@Was I lured out here?)
Ing, the Steel Dragons are here.
Ryoto, Ing, are you all right?!
(Vete... I could settle things with that woman here.)
(They're the ones who did that to <Team Jelba>...@to Lieutenant Albada and Lieutenant Serena...!)
Balshem units, artificial humans@of the <Ze Balmary Empire>.
We still don't really know@what they're after.
Then why are they out here...?!
If they're searching for something tied to <Euzeth>@like they were at Monte di Lupo...
They may have learned something's wrong@with the Cross Gate that man tried to absorb,@and come to investigate.
Yes, that's an undeniable fact.@But if they have no proof of that...
They may have targeted Ing, who'd gone ahead,@to get even the smallest lead on that man.
Either way, now that we're here,@we won't let them do as they please!
That's right. All units, commence attack!
Unknown approaching!@From three o'clock, elevation 20, straight at us!
Don't go in too deep, Spectra.
Don't forget what we must do.@I'll draw them off. You withdraw.
No. Precisely because the Cross Gate@is acting abnormally, I can't pull back now.
This may be our last chance@to abduct Eagret Ing.
Isn't it Vete you're fixated on?
Even so, I don't intend to stay here long.@I'll judge when it's time to withdraw.
Another unit with a different shape and color...!
That one looks like a commander unit too.
This must be fate as well. I'll play with you for a while.
Pull back, Ein. You can't go any further.
Fall back, Spectra. I'll cover the rear.
...Very well.@Vete, Ing... Until we meet again.@If we get the chance, that is.
(Now, what will happen to the Cross Gate...@I must see that for myself.)
All enemy signals in the combat area are gone!
Attention all ships.@Once all units are recovered, we head@straight for Cross Gate Space.
I know you're Balshem!@Why are you after me?!
(Don't tell me you have no idea...!)
This one's different from the other Balshem...!
(If you are truly the chosen one, then I...)
(! It stopped...? What on earth was that...?)
(A system malfunction?@Regardless, I will complete my mission.)
The way that commander unit moves... Could it be...?
So in the end, Ing got@lured out by those guys?
If that were true, I think they'd have struck@farther away from the Steel Dragons...
Ing, what was the presence you sensed like?
It was vague... I felt something like a gaze.
And the Balshem were at the end of it?
I felt like it wasn't just them, though...
In any case, I don't think they noticed us@until just before, either.
Then just as Lieutenant Raidiese predicted, their@real objective was investigating the Cross Gate...?
(The reason the Balshem are after me...)
(When we went to the ruins of the <Garden of Baral>,@the Balshem were fighting <Team Jelba>...)
(The mission Lieutenant Serena's team was on@back then is classified, so I don't know the details.)
(But I can't believe Team Jelba and the Balshem@just ran into each other there by chance.@There must be something in common, including this...)
Are you kidding me? Rigging the cockpit with a bomb?!@What do you take us for?!
...This was decided by the Joint Chiefs of Staff.
You can't expect me to accept that!
Listen, there are two reasons.@First, as a countermeasure in case@Her Highness Princess Shana-Mia aids the enemy.
And second, in case the Throne Unit@falls into Gu-Landon's hands... correct?
Even so, threatening us with a bomb...!
If they were truly heartless,@I doubt they'd tell us about the explosives.
They'd plant them in silence and set them off@the moment things became inconvenient.
Furthermore, I'm the only one who knows of this.@So you're forbidden to tell anyone.
That includes Katia Grineal, Festenia Muse@and Melua Melna Meia.@Is that clear?
What happens if I tell someone?@You'll pull me off the Granteed?
It's to avoid needless confusion within the unit...
Commander, urgent message from the Cross Gate@Watch Fleet! A <Zovorg> mobile force has@warped in ahead of the fleet!
What?!@Tell the captain to enter the special alert@zone at maximum battle speed!
Your Highness, you heard.@Depending on the situation, we may ask you@to sortie in the Granteed Dracodeus.
As I told you before, I'm prepared.@I will aid you in bringing all this to an end.
You want me to fight and show you proof, right?@Proof that I'm an Earthling.
But I'll fight as one of the Fury, too.@So I don't deny the blood my father gave me.
And so that no one else can deny it...
...Going any deeper is undesirable.@We'll withdraw beyond lunar orbit for now and watch.
Isn't now, with everyone in chaos over the@Cross Gate, exactly our chance?
We've had too much careless contact with the Steel@Dragons. We can't let them realize our objective.
And we must deal with the Cross Gate carefully.@All the more so in a state like that.
That's exactly why Ing, as a lead...
No.@From now on, do not interfere... Not even with Vete.
Ein, that is a strict order for your people as well.
